name: frandex-vision
title: Frandex — зрение и память агента
summary: Локальный MCP-сервер: распознавание сцен (CLIP), лиц (InsightFace), память по изображениям и поиск по ней. Наружу не ходит, работает на своём железе.

transport.note: Paths are omitted on purpose. The server runs from its own install directory on the caller's host; publishing absolute paths would leak the owner's filesystem layout without helping anyone install it.

tools.name: look
tools.description: CLIP: класс сцены и описание изображения

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Записать изображение и заметку в память (ChromaDB)

permissions.filesystem: reads images under caller-provided paths; writes only to vector store

audit_trail.author: Gella / Quant Studio
audit_trail.license: proprietary — read and apply, do not redistribute as your own

install.setup: Place frandex_mcp.py next to the frandex core, install requirements into a venv, point your MCP client at the venv python and the script. Model files are fetched from their upstream pages.
install.status: not published — private integration, access by request

integrity.note: Digest covers this record's own bytes. Signature not yet implemented — do not treat as provenance proof.

security_assessment.note: Moderation checks the record, not the code. public does not mean safe.
